No application source, data, threshold, test, archive or build changed.

findings.title: README.md describes the checks wrongly again and calls the file self-contained (the prior audit's R-1 recurred)
findings.user_impact: A contributor or reviewer reading README.md is told check:data compares against step 5c's build, check:contrast reads 35 states and six start-up cases, the self-test has 242 checks in about 15 minutes, check:visual 30 views in about 100 minutes, audit.js only prints, and that the HTML is self-contained although three.js comes from cdnjs.
findings.origin: inherited (step 6 item 3 made the states and views stale) / new-regression (Stage 8 PRs 8A-8K moved the reference, the counts and the times)
findings.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/records/doc-consistency.md (every quoted phrase re-read on its line by doc-consistency.py); docs/audit-post8-evidence/checks/check-contrast.txt ("states 45 (10 at 390 x 844 as a phone)", "boot cases: 8 of 8 pass"); CHANGELOG.md:1936 (audit.js asserts since step 5)
findings.expected: README's table matches package.json and the checks as they run (archive/stage8k-f10fe585.html; 45 states; 8 start-up cases; 317 checks; 39 views), and says three.js loads from cdnjs.
findings.observed: 9 stale statements in README.md (lines 4, 27, 28, 30 twice, 31 twice, 32 twice) and one in checks.yml:5 ("each about 8-15 minutes"; the self-test alone takes 21-43 minutes on CI). README.md last changed at 15b2dcc (decision 214).
findings.remedy: A records-only commit: point README's table at CLAUDE.md's Checks section instead of copying counts and times, or update them; write "one HTML file; three.js r128 is loaded from cdnjs with its integrity hash".
findings.validation: python3 -I tools/audit-post8/records/doc-consistency.py then reads the corrected lines (its quotes would no longer be found).

findings.expected: Each merged part's status line says "merged (#n, commit)", as step 5 made them (CHANGELOG.md:1854).

findings.title: The carried checklist misstates three of its own items (the records' view of other areas' findings)
findings.user_impact: The checklist the final audit was to start from understates three items: a reader would take them as small offsets and a 4-second gap.
findings.evidence: history finding 8 (kienmayer@7 "Holding west of the Goldbach" drawn 901 m east of the brook since Stage 0, filed by 8J as an offset from the corrected brook); history finding 9 (Caffarelli 1.61-2.64 km from Bagration, the records say 2.5-2.9 km); visibility carried and findings 1, 3 (the 4,033 ms is the benchmark's whole 121-frame window; over 08:30-11:30 counters hidden 12-28 s); docs/audit-post8-evidence/records/carried.md C-06, C-40, C-41
findings.expected: The checklist states each item as measured.
findings.observed: An offset since Stage 0 filed as 8J's; a separation overstated; a saturated measure read as a duration.
findings.remedy: Let this register (carried.md) supersede section 22.6's wording; correct the three lines when the records are next touched.
findings.validation: The history and visibility areas' probes.
